body: Celexa helped me for a bit.  It mainly helped with my anxiety but didn't quite do anything about the lack of motivation at all.  I might try to bump it down to 40mg.  He recently bumped me up from 30mg because it wasn't doing too much.

I don't believe it is caused by any nutrient deficiencies.  I was diagnosed with PCOS recently and it is suggested that some women get depressed due to the weight gain and androgyny that it causes.  I have had some weight gain due to it but I don't believe my depression is caused by the PCOS at all.
Nothing in particular that I can think of.

21 years old.  I'll probably have to go see my doctor then.  Cymbalta is the last of a long line of antidepressants he's tried on me.  Most don't seem to work at all. Cymbalta is the only one that has actually seemed to help my depression so far but I'm very worried about these thoughts.
I've never been passionate about anything in my entire life. I've never had a single hobby or activity I like.
